response.sql: WITH scan_metrics AS (SELECT crewref, gbsize / spanmin as gb_per_min FROM scans WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL), operator_stats AS (SELECT crewref, AVG(gb_per_min) as avg_gb_per_min, COUNT(*) as scan_count FROM scan_metrics GROUP BY crewref), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_min) as overall_avg FROM scan_metrics), filtered AS (SELECT os.crewref, os.avg_gb_per_min, os.scan_count, oa.overall_avg FROM operator_stats os CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE os.avg_gb_per_min > oa.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(scan_count) as avg_scans, AVG(avg_gb_per_min) as avg_gb_per_min, AVG(avg_gb_per_min - overall_avg) as avg_excess FROM filtered
